title: The Memo Nobody Argued With
tagline: Structure is what a reader can follow. Story is what a reader can find again.
description: Why your clearest document is the one nobody acted on, and where the second anchor goes. Walk out able to run the open-structure-close sequence on your own drafts and to test any document in under a minute.

title: The Paper You Read Twice
tagline: Write by supplying the six. Read by finding which one is absent.
description: The six pillars of sticky communication, run backward as a reading diagnostic. Walk out able to name which of the six a piece was missing and supply it yourself in ninety seconds, and knowing why the same test lies to you about your own drafts.
